caretaker.speaker: reserve_caretaker
caretaker.text: *looks up with a smile* Caelan. Mind that little one's roots, will you? They're just under the path.

caretaker.speaker: caelan
caretaker.text: It's looking better than it did last time.

caretaker.speaker: reserve_caretaker
caretaker.text: A little shade helped. And a great deal of watching it and pretending I wasn't worried.

caretaker.speaker: reserve_caretaker
caretaker.text: I've got these. Take a walk while it's quiet. People have been coming up all morning.

caretaker.speaker: reserve_caretaker
caretaker.text: Some sit a while. Some help with the trees. We make room for both.

caretaker.speaker: reserve_caretaker
caretaker.text: And mind the rope across the cave. The footing inside still needs checking.

visitors.speaker: reserve_visitor_slate
visitors.text: That sapling's taller than me now.

visitors.speaker: reserve_visitor_slate
visitors.text: Last year I was standing downhill.

visitors.speaker: reserve_visitor_plum
visitors.text: His mother used to bring us here. She always found this bench first.

visitors.speaker: reserve_visitor_slate
visitors.text: *rests a hand on the back of the bench* She liked to say everyone else could walk another lap.

boundary.speaker: caelan
boundary.text: *reads the weathered marker* Elden Vale Sanctuary.

boundary.speaker: caelan
boundary.text: The boundary stones go right around the wooded ridge. Someone's been keeping the ivy off the marks.

grove.speaker: caelan
grove.text: *pauses beneath the silver-green branches* Even the fallen blossoms seem to catch the light.

grove.speaker: caelan
grove.text: Serene says the aether gathers here naturally. It's easier to notice when I stand still.

cave.speaker: caelan
cave.text: *stops at the rope* The crystals catch the light all the way up the rock. It's cool this close to them.

cave.speaker: caelan
cave.text: There's old stonework between them, just inside.

cave.speaker: caelan
cave.text: *reads the notice* Closed while the inner path is checked.

cave.speaker: caelan
cave.text: I'll leave the rope where it is.

survey.speaker: caelan
survey.text: *studies the marks on the board* The stone face is well clear of the hall.

survey.speaker: caelan
survey.text: Still inside the sanctuary boundary, though. Nothing's been cut here.

records.speaker: caelan
records.text: A visitors' ledger. Names, work done in the grove, repairs that need seeing to...

records.speaker: caelan
records.text: *smiles at an entry* Someone's written 'fixed the same bench again.'

remembrance.speaker: caelan
remembrance.text: Fresh flowers. The candles have been trimmed, too.

cabinet.speaker: caelan
cabinet.text: Grove accounts, repair books, old plans... They've kept these carefully.

cabinet.speaker: caelan
cabinet.text: I'd better leave them in order.
